description: Upload a local image and set it on a field of an existing Sanity document in one call. Overwrites the current value of that field. Use groq_query first to find the document ID. The document is checked before uploading, so a wrong ID uploads nothing. The given ID is patched exactly as written (use `drafts.<id>` to patch a draft). A bare ID that has only ever existed as a draft patches `drafts.<id>`. If you patch a published document that also has a draft, the response includes a `note` saying so.

alt.description: Alt text (derived from filename if omitted)

dataset.description: Sanity dataset (falls back to SANITY_DATASET env, then 'production')

documentId.description: Sanity document ID to patch: a published ID, or `drafts.<id>` to patch the draft

fieldPath.description: Path to the image field, dot-separated for nested objects (e.g. 'hero.image')

filePath.description: Absolute path to the image file

projectId.description: Sanity project ID (falls back to SANITY_PROJECT_ID env)

name: upload_and_set
